title: Athletic Training Sourcer
description:
Overview
Planned Systems International , Inc. (PSI) is seeking a motivated and relationship-driven Athletic Training Sourcer to join our established internal Corporate Talent Acquisition team to support the hiring and staffing efforts for our nationwide military health and human performance programs. This opportunity is ideal for Certified Athletic Trainers (ATCs) who are passionate about the profession and interested in transitioning into a rewarding recruiting and talent acquisition career while continuing to support fellow athletic trainers nationwide.
In this role, you will leverage your athletic training background, professional network, and understanding of the athletic training profession to identify, engage, and build relationships with Certified Athletic Trainers supporting our rapidly growing military health and human performance programs across the country. You will partner closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and program leadership to develop talent pipelines and connect qualified athletic trainers with meaningful career opportunities that support soldier readiness, injury prevention, rehabilitation, and overall performance for our nation's active-duty military personnel.
This is an exciting opportunity to stay connected to the athletic training profession while expanding your career into talent acquisition, workforce planning, and healthcare staffing.
Essential Functions and Job Responsibilities

• Source and identify Certified Athletic Trainers (ATCs) for nationwide military health and human performance programs.

• Utilize your understanding of the athletic training profession to proactively engage qualified candidates and build long-term talent pipelines.

• Conduct targeted searches using professional networks, social media platforms, databases, referrals, and industry-specific resources.

• Build and maintain relationships within the athletic training community through professional associations, universities, networking groups, conferences, and online communities.

• Conduct initial outreach and candidate engagement activities to assess interest, qualifications, and availability.

• Partner with recruiters and hiring managers to understand staffing needs and develop sourcing strategies.

• Maintain and nurture candidate pipelines for current and future hiring needs.

• Attend virtual and in-person recruiting events, conferences, and networking opportunities to expand candidate networks.

• Create candidate profiles, sourcing summaries, and market intelligence reports for recruiters and hiring teams.

• Support recruitment marketing initiatives and employer branding efforts targeting athletic training professionals.

• Maintain accurate sourcing activity and candidate records within the applicant tracking system (ATS) and CRM tools.

• Ensure compliance with applicable employment laws, OFCCP requirements, company policies, and recruiting best practices.

• Monitor industry trends, market conditions, and competitive talent landscapes within athletic training and healthcare staffing.

• Participate in recruiting team meetings and contribute to sourcing strategy discussions.

• Support additional talent acquisition projects and workforce planning initiatives across PSI and its subsidiaries as needed.

Minimum Requirements

• Bachelor’s Degree required; additional experience may be considered in lieu of degree requirements.

• Certified Athletic Trainer (ATC) credential strongly preferred.

• Prior experience as a Certified Athletic Trainer, healthcare recruiter, talent sourcer, or in a relationship-driven professional role preferred.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport quickly with candidates across various levels of experience as well as internal stakeholders.

• Interest in recruiting, talent acquisition, workforce planning, and career development.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong organizational skil

title: Sales Representative (m/w/d) - Frankfurt
description:
Du hast erste Vertriebserfahrung und willst jetzt richtig loslegen? Bei uns bekommst du ein strukturierteres Onboarding, dein eigenes Gebiet, kurze Sales-Cycles und ein Team, das dich weiterentwickelt.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70% weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Du planst deine Woche eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Nachweisbare erste Erfahrung im Vertrieb, idealerweise mit Outbound-Anteil (Kaltakquise, Walk-ins, eigene Terminierung).

- Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch - egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

- Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

- Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist strukturiert und organisiert.

- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Strukturierte Einarbeitung und praxisnahe Begleitung über die ersten Monate hinweg (Ramp-Up Programm).

- Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: Von Junior- über Senior- und bis hin zu Führungsrollen..

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die den Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Team-Formate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

title: Senior Security Solutions Engineer
description:
Description
Hypernative is the leader in real-time threat prevention for Web3. We empower protocols, bridges, and DeFi platforms to detect and prevent exploits before they happen. Our platform is trusted by leading crypto-native organizations to protect billions of dollars in on-chain value. Backed by world-class investors and experiencing rapid growth, we’re building a customer-centric organization that helps our customers stay safe, agile, and ahead of threats.
We’re looking for a Senior Security Solutions Engineer for a hands-on, customer-facing role, working directly with our US-based customers to implement and optimize their security operations using the Hypernative platform.
This is a hands-on, customer-facing role that works closely with our US team to support customers throughout the day. You'll be embedded directly in customer environments: configuring and customizing the Hypernative platform, scripting integrations and custom monitoring logic in Python, and guiding customers through implementation and day-to-day use of our security tools.
If you're passionate about blockchain and cybersecurity and looking for a challenging, customer-facing role with a dynamic, innovative team, we encourage you to apply.
Responsibilities

• Risk Strategy - assist customers in conducting thorough analyses of their Web3 assets, evaluate their security postures, and assess associated risks; advise on optimal configurations for risk monitoring tools; and develop comprehensive monitoring and response plans covering preventive measures, detection techniques, and incident response strategies

• Customer Collaboration and Support - maintain continuous communication with customers, keeping them informed of potential security issues and shifts in the threat landscape

• Partner Collaboration - work with technology and ecosystem partners on joint integrations and solutions that support customer environments

• Training and Enablement - deliver security training and enablement sessions to client teams, from technical staff to non-technical stakeholders

• Sales Support - support Sales on professional services scoping, proposals, and technical positioning

• Implementation and Configuration - configure and customize the Hypernative platform for each customer's environment, including custom rules, integrations, and Python scripting, and provide hands-on support to ensure security practices integrate cleanly with existing workflows

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field

• In-depth understanding of Web3 technologies, decentralized systems, and blockchain security concepts

• Advanced understanding of cybersecurity principles, best practices, and industry standards as they apply to digital assets and blockchain technologies

• Working proficiency in Python for scripting, integrations, and custom monitoring logic

• Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively, including with external partners

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex security concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

• Proven track record of effective customer-facing engagements, with patience, professionalism, and a customer-first attitude

title: Product Operations Intern, Rewards
description:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with a wide range of flexible payment options designed to give customers more choice, accessibility, and a smarter overall experience. We're not just transforming payments; we're redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we're building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you're excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a curious, driven, and detail-oriented Product Operations Intern to join our Rewards team. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Rewards is where Sezzle turns everyday shopping into value for our customers. Through the Earn experience in the Sezzle app, shoppers earn Sezzle Points by scanning receipts, completing offers, and engaging with our partners. Receipt scanning is one of our newest and fastest-growing earning features, and you'll be one of the people closest to it. You'll see how it works in the real world, find where it breaks, and help decide what gets fixed first.

This is an operations role with a strong product lens. You'll work with the product manager, engineering, design, and data teams to make sure the receipt scanning experience is accurate, fair, and hard to abuse. Your work will feed directly into what the team builds next. If you like finding patterns in messy real-world data and turning them into clear recommendations, this role is for you.

What You'll Do:

Receipt Quality & Validation Operations

• Own the day-to-day quality of receipt scanning submissions. Review submissions against validation rules, make approve/reject decisions, and apply them consistently.

• Spot edge cases the current system misses, such as unusual receipt formats, retailer-specific quirks, duplicates, and signs of abuse. Document them clearly so the team can handle them at scale.

Product Feedback & Prioritization

• Turn what you see in submissions into actionable feedback for engineering: clear bug reports, reproducible examples, and suggested improvements to extraction and validation logic.

• Keep a prioritized list of what needs improvement and why. Rank it by customer impact, fraud risk, and operational cost, and help the product manager bring it into planning.

The Financial Controller is the senior accounting leader for the operating business and its acquired entities. Reporting to corporate finance and partnering with operating leadership, this role manages the full accounting lifecycle, working capital, and acquisition integration.
This hands-on position ensures accurate books, timely closes, system reconciliations, disciplined cash operations, credit risk monitoring, and robust internal controls while delivering operating data to support parent-level reporting and M&A execution.
Key Responsibilities
Accounting & Close Management

Systems & Reconciliations

Payables & Cash Management

Team Leadership

Authority & Boundaries

• Controller Authority: Enforces accounting policies, close timelines, payment controls, and credit holds across operating entities.

• Corporate Ownership: Parent/holding company finance retains final authority over annual budgets, strategic pricing, capital allocation, M&A execution, and material credit limit exceptions.

Qualifications
Required

• Experience: 7+ years in progressive accounting, with 3+ years as Controller or Assistant Controller.

• Core Skills: Hands-on multi-entity month-end close, high-volume AP/AR management, 13-week cash forecasting, and customer credit administration.

• Technical: Strong US GAAP knowledge, internal control design, and advanced Excel.

•
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.

Working Conditions

title: Senior Supplier Quality Engineer, Altius
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Launched Effects team at Anduril is responsible for scaling the manufacturing and delivery of the ALTIUS family of systems (including the ALTIUS-600 and ALTIUS-700). As the premier Air-Launched Effects (ALE) platform for the U.S. military and its allies, ALTIUS is redefining modern warfare. These tube-launched, autonomous aerial systems must be built to survive extreme deployment environments, requiring precision manufacturing of advanced composites, complex avionics, and modular payload integrations for ISR, Electronic Warfare, and kinetic strike capabilities.

As part of the Launched Effects manufacturing team, you will bridge the gap between cutting-edge R&D and high-rate production. We are a fast-moving, mission-driven group of manufacturing engineers, quality specialists, and production operations experts who refuse to accept traditional, slow defense manufacturing timelines. We continuously optimize our assembly lines, implement automated testing, design for manufacturing (DFM), and build resilient supply chains to deploy reliable systems to the front lines at unprecedented speed. If you want to work on a team where your production and manufacturing decisions directly impact global security, this is it.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Senior Supply Quality Engineer, you will work inside & outside the organization to define, develop, and execute processes that deliver high quality & reliable precision machined parts used in our missile and high-speed aircraft programs. This role focuses on collaborating and driving early engagement with our design teams and suppliers to meet our quality requirements the first time. Everything comes down to clarity and action with our suppliers and partnering with them for world class results across the supply chain. The right person for this role has knowledge of manufacturing, supply management, supplier development, sub-system performance criteria, metrology, and continuous improvement. If you are someone who loves to build world-class quality processes with suppliers, work hands-on with engineering, and be accountable for results, then this role is for you.

This position is permanently based in Atlanta, GA, and requires candidates to temporarily relocate for a comprehensive 1-month training program in  Santa Ana, CA . To support your transition, Anduril will fully provide and cover all corporate housing, transportation, and travel accommodations during this training period. Your recruiter will discuss the logistics of this program with you in detail during the hiring process.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Partner with our design teams to support the design development process, provide design for manufacturability feedback, and help generate product data (drawings details, BOM information, and part requirements) for precision mechanical parts that lead to supplier quality success.

• Use your knowledge and expertise of machining, molding, additive manufacturing, fabrication, special processes, and inspection/measurement to support the internal Anduril design process and ideation. Provide leadership to manage technical risks, proof of concepts, prototyping, and scaling designs for volume production.

• Drive the supplier quality development processes throughout

日本におけるIdeals VDR事業の急速な拡大を支援するため、東京オフィスを拠点とする営業担当／アカウントエグゼクティブ（アウトバウンドセールス）を募集しています。現在の3名の営業チームに加わり、日本フィールドセールスチームの創設メンバーとして、アウトバウンド営業を積極的に展開し、新規顧客を獲得して成約に至ることが最終目標となります。

トップラインを担うクォータ制メンバーとして、新規顧客への積極的なアプローチとセールス パイプラインの管理を行います。金融・銀行をはじめとする各業界の経営幹部や主要意思決定者と積極的に関わり、日本市場における当社の成長に直接貢献するとともに、カントリーディレクターと緊密に連携します。

使用技術スタック：HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Amplemarket, Clay, Apollo, Phantombuster, Woodpecker, Aircall

勤務地：丸の内二重橋ビルディング https://share.google/OlRR71fi2tFFW620J (ハイブリッドワーキング/リモートファースト)

※商談の際はクライアント先へ訪問していただきますが、それ以外の通常業務は在宅勤務（リモートワーク）が可能です。

 

なぜIDEALSか？

- 営業担当者からの高い信頼：Idealsは営業プロフェッショナルによる評価で、RepVue https://www.repvue.com/companies/iDealsにおいて上位10％の企業にランクインしています。

- 成長の機会：G2 https://www.g2.com/categories/virtual-data-room?tab=highest_rated とUpGuard https://www.upguard.com/security-report/ideals-virtual-data-roomで最高評価を獲得した主力製品であるVDRで収益を4倍に拡大した、ブートストラップ方式のSaaS企業で成長を加速させましょう。

- 実績ある組織：17年以上のVDR事業実績、前年比30％超の収益成長、世界のM&A取引の10％以上を支える確立された組織の一員となれます。

 

主な業務内容

- 日本における主要ステークホルダーや業界インフルエンサーとの関係構築

- 新規顧客獲得に注力し、売上目標の達成

- 日本の戦略的アカウントと連携し、積極的にパイプラインを構築・管理するとともに、常に新たな機会を開拓

- 営業・マーケティング戦略の実行に積極的に貢献

- M&Aコミュニティイベントの企画運営に参加し、Idealsの認知度向上を図る

- 顧客に対する説得力のある製品プレゼンテーションを実施する

- 取引の構造化、交渉、成約を遂行する

- 顧客へのインサイト共有と進捗報告を継続的に行う

- 製品開発・管理チームへ適切な顧客フィードバックを提供する

- カスタマーサクセスおよびインサイドセールスと連携し、顧客満足度と企業収益の向上を図る

 

募集要項

- B2Bにおけるフル360度クロージング業務またはプロフェッショナルサービス分野での1-2年以上の実務経験

- IT, SaaS もしくは金融業界での経験

- パイプライン管理と成約実績の成功事例

- 説得力のある提案構築と顧客ニーズ把握を可能とする卓越したビジネスコミュニケーション能力

- 日本語ネイティブレベル、ビジネス英語

 

優遇条件

- 金融業界の主要プレイヤー及び市場動向に関する知識

- C-suite（経営幹部層）とのコミュニケーション経験

- 高速販売環境での経験と、経営幹部層（C-Level）との高いコミュニケーション能力

- SaaS及びVDR（バーチャルデータルーム）業界での経験

- 上級レベルの英語力

 

当社が提供する環境

私たちは人材を最も重視しています。そのため、あなたの可能性を最大限に引き出すためのあらゆるリソースとサポートを提供します。

 

最高の仕事のために

- 理想的な勤務形態を実現するハイブリッド勤務の柔軟性

- 在宅勤務環境整備のための予算

- コワーキングスペース利用費の補助

- 追加機器購入のための個人IT予算

- 最先端技術とAI搭載ツール

 

成長のために

- 豊富な講座を提供する「Ideals Academy」へのアクセス

- 外部研修・能力開発活動への投資

- 個人開発計画（PDP）作成の指導

- 専門書籍・定期購読料の補助

- 講演者・執筆者としての活動支援

- 社内異動の機会

 

ウェルビーイングのために

- 心身の健康をサポートするカスタマイズ型ウェルネスパッケージ

- スポーツ競技への資金援助

- 健康関連有給休暇

- 年間15営業日の年次有給休暇

 

追加特典

- グローバル拠点での地域交流会予算

- 充実した社内紹介制度

私たちの文化

献身、卓越性、協働、信頼、思いやりは、アイデアルズチームの核心的価値観です。私たちは、これらの価値観を共有する志を同じくする人材を求めています。そうすることで、才能ある人々が安心して能力を最大限に発揮できるチームを創り上げます。

詳細はこちら https://ideals.jobs/our-culture/.

アイデアルズは機会均等雇用主です。多様な背景やライフスタイルを持つ人材で構成されています。私たちは多様性を尊重し、あらゆる分野の方々からの応募を歓迎します。性別同一性・表現、性的指向、人種、宗教、年齢、国籍、市民権に基づく従業員や応募者への差別は一切行いません。

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
WHO WE ARE

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac https://spreadprivacy.com/introducing-duckduckgo-for-mac/, Windows https://spreadprivacy.com/windows-browser-open-beta/, iOS https://spreadprivacy.com/duckduckgo-privacy-browser-ios14/, and Android https://spreadprivacy.com/introducing-app-tracking-protection/, our search engine https://duckduckgo.com/, and the DuckDuckGo subscription https://duckduckgo.com/pro. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai https://duck.ai/, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture https://duckduckgo.com/how-we-work of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

YOUR TEAM AND ROLE

Working on the Data Science Functional Team, you'll drive product and business impact through statistical modeling, experiment design, Bayesian marketing analysis, and classifier implementation across our search engine, instant answers, AI, and revenue optimization, and work on related projects. Recent projects include:

- Defining core growth metrics for our products and building the infrastructure to monitor trends and anomalies

- Measuring the impact of major marketing campaigns for Duck.ai http://duck.ai, translating full-funnel data into actionable decisions

- Building monitoring pipelines to detect unexpected shifts in search traffic patterns faster and more reliably

- Expanding evaluation datasets for page context understanding across complex scenarios like multi-tab browsing and content reattachment

- Improving the trigger systems that determine when AI-assisted answers surface in DuckDuckGo Search, balancing quality and our privacy-first approach

 

Our data meets rigorous privacy standards and is necessarily sparse, so you'll need to think creatively to surface actionable insights in an evidence-first culture where quantitative rigor is the baseline, not the exception.

 

ABOUT YOU

- You have 7+ years of experience in Data Science and a track record of leading high-complexity projects from scoping to production with minimal direction.

- You can do 2 or more of the following:

- Deploy and iterate on ML in production environments

- Develop and deploy NLP solutions

- Apply knowledge of LLMs including fine-tuning, LLM-as-judge, and AI-assisted development

- Conduct marketing campaign analysis using Bayesian methods

- You write production-grade code in Python or a comparable high-level language.

- You have advanced SQL and query optimization skills, familiarity with columnar databases like BigQuery, Clickhouse, Redshift, or Druid; experience with a BI tool like Tableau or PowerBI is a plus.

- You can design, implement, and analyze experiments across product surfaces, and are comfortable deriving insights from sparse or privacy-constrained data.

- You collaborate effectively with product teams and contribute to overall team throughput.

COMPENSATION

$178,500 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.

 

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

description:
ABOUT RADIANT

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale - powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our operations and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we are looking to expand our finance team with leaders who can combine technical strength with execution excellence and are driven to build.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Location: UK (occasional travel to data centre and test environments, confirm exact cadence) | Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent | Reports to: VP Information Security

We're looking for a Principal/ Staff Security Engineer to join Infosec, reporting to our VP InfoSec. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role. You will need a deep, technical understanding of Kubernetes clusters, network architecture and access controls to manage our production environment.

As we move toward owning and operating more of our own data centre footprint, the accuracy of our firewall policies, network access controls and technical security testing matters more than ever. This role will build our internal penetration testing capability, so testing becomes more targeted and accurate over time, working alongside our external testers rather than replacing them. You will need to work proactively across engineering teams so knowledge does not sit with one person alone.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

SECURITY TESTING & AUDIT:

- Audit firewall policies and network access controls across the estate.

- Conduct internal penetration testing, working alongside our external penetration testing partners.

- Build a penetration testing strategy and cadence that improves accuracy and coverage over time.

- Identify and help remediate security gaps found through testing and audit.

PRODUCTION ESTATE & TECHNICAL DEPTH:

- Build and maintain a deep, working understanding of our production environment, including Kubernetes clusters, network architecture and access controls.

- Investigate technical issues directly and dig into root cause, rather than relying on reported findings alone.

- Support the VP Infosec on controls testing across the Production Estate.

ACCESS & ENVIRONMENT MANAGEMENT:

- Own and maintain SSO and systems access configuration.

- Build and maintain penetration testing environments, including small Kubernetes clusters as needed.

- Maintain the tooling and infrastructure supporting security testing.

COLLABORATION:

- Work proactively across engineering teams to avoid becoming a single point of knowledge or failure.

- Document processes, findings and configurations so knowledge is shared, not siloed.

- Partner with the Head of Security Operations on shared governance, risk reporting and security testing.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- Strong Kubernetes experience, with the technical depth to investigate and resolve issues directly.

- Experience auditing firewall policies and network access controls.

- Experience conducting or coordinating penetration testing.

- Comfortable maintaining and operating security tooling and environments on an ongoing basis.

- Strong written communication skills, given the solo nature

At Kyndryl , we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people- Kyndryl s-that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.
The Role

Are you ready to join Kyndryl ’s CIO Hire‑to‑Retire organization as a Senior Lead, Software Engineering Specialist - Workday Benefits ? We are seeking an experienced, independently driven Workday practitioner to design, configure, and support Benefits solutions with Workday as the system of record.

In this role, you will serve as a subject matter expert for Workday Benefits, owning solution design, configuration, testing, and deployment across global business requirements. You will partner closely with HR, Payroll, and downstream teams to deliver accurate, compliant, and scalable solutions that support both day‑to‑day operations and evolving business needs.

You will be responsible for translating business requirements into Workday configuration solutions, advising on best practices, identifying impacts across related domains, and ensuring solutions are sustainable and supportable. This role requires the ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and drive work to completion with limited oversight.

You will collaborate with integration partners and technical teams where needed, but your primary focus will be on functional configuration, solution quality, and business outcomes, rather than custom development. This role offers the opportunity to be a key contributor to a business‑critical HR platform supporting Kyndryl ’s global workforce, supporting cross‑functional solution and assessing end‑to‑end impacts across the Hire‑to‑Retire lifecycle.

Your Future at Kyndryl
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands‑on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

Who You Are
You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important - you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused - someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless - naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Technical and Professional Expertise

• 7+ years of hands‑on Workday configuration experience, with deep expertise in Benefits

• Proven ability to independently design and deliver Workday configuration solutions, from requirements through deployment

• Strong understanding of benefits, and payroll‑related business processes, including downstream impacts

• Experience supporting production Workday environments, including troubleshooting and configuration changes in live systems

• Experience supporting global or multi‑country Workday deployments

• Familiarity with Workday business process frameworks, security considerations, and reporting impacts related to Time and Absence

• Ability to translate business requirements into scalable, supportable Workday solutions using best‑practice configuration approaches

• Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills in an enterprise, cross‑functional environment

Preferred Technical and Professional Experience

• Experience working in a matrixed or global team

title: Senior ML Engineer
description:
Social Discovery Group (SDG) is a group of social discovery companies. SDG solves the problems of loneliness, isolation, and disconnection - transforming virtual intimacy into the new normal. SDG’s products redefine the way people interact and connect with one another.

Our portfolio includes social entertainment platforms designed to connect people online across different cultures and regions of the world.

We bring together a team of like-minded people and IT professionals who specialize in creating and developing globally impactful social discovery products. Our international team of digital nomads works remotely from all over the world.

We’re proud to be a two-time “Great Place to Work” winner (USA & Japan, 2024-2025) and a Top-5 Company for Work-From-Anywhere Jobs (FlexJobs, 2025).

We are looking for Machine Learning Engineer.

Your main tasks will be:

• Set the ML direction: choose which strategic bets to make and tie each one to clear business needs.

• Drive LLM post-training and model adaptation end to end, from dataset construction to fine-tuning and preference optimization.

• Design and build agent harnesses and tool-using LLM systems.

• Shape multi-agent development workflows that make the team faster and more effective.

• Build evaluation frameworks and LLM-as-a-judge systems that reliably predict real-world performance.

• Improve dialogue quality across memory, emotional intelligence, persona consistency, safety and anti-loop behavior.

• Ship production systems that directly shape user experience, retention and monetization.

We expect from you:

• Python expert level: clean code, typing, async, multiprocessing, profiling, debugging, notebooks + production code.Trainsformers.

• Training and fine-tuning LLMs.

• SFT, LoRA/QLoRA, PEFT.

• Preference optimization: DPO / ORPO / SimPO / CPO / GRPO or willingness to quickly go deep.

• Building datasets for LLM training: cleaning, filtering, deduplication, preference pairs, synthetic data, hard negative mining.

• LLM evaluation: offline evals, pairwise evals, LLM judges, human annotation.

• Agent harness design: tool calling, function calling, structured outputs, retries, routing, state management, memory/context, guardrails.

• Production LLM integration: APIs, streaming, batching, fallbacks, cost/latency trade-offs.

• Observability for agents: traces, tool-call logs, transcript analysis, failure clustering.

• Strong understanding of transformer architecture and modern LLM behavior.

• Accuracy with dtype/device/batching: fp32/fp16/bf16, quantization, CUDA memory, avoiding dtype mismatch bugs.

• Git, Docker, Linux, basic MLOps.

• Fluent Russian, ready to work in CET (±2) hours.

Nice to have: experience beyond text (computer vision, image generation, multimodal), long-running conversations and character consistency, vLLM / TGI / SGLang, DeepSpeed / FSDP / Accelerate, quantization, safety classifiers.

title: Mission Systems - Payload Lead, Maritime

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's Maritime Division is transforming American sea power to meet the defining national security challenges of our era and secure our future of maritime dominance.  We are scaling at an historic pace, anchored by Arsenal-2, our new software-defined shipyard being built in Baltimore County, Maryland. It's part of a new $6.6 billion investment in America's submarine industrial base.

Arsenal-2 i s purpose-built to break long-standing industrial bottlenecks and scale production of critical components for the Navy's Virginia-class attack submarines to support fleet requirements. At the same time, it will build the industrial muscle to field our next-generation Next-generation AUVs at scale.

We aren't waiting for the new shipyard to be completed. The work on this transformation starts right now, with development inside our new 160,000 square foot Proto-Factory in Orange County, California , where the team is already laying the foundation. As the prototyping hub for Arsenal-2, this facility gives us a multi-year head start, proving out the advanced manufacturing methods, digital workflows, and quality systems that will scale across our broader shipyard network.

In Anduril's Maritime Division, we are actively building America's next decisive advantage at sea-and t his is the moment to join us.

ABOUT THE JOB

You will own payload integration within Mission Systems for a maritime autonomous vehicle, owning integration of Anduril and third-party payloads from concept through deployment. Reporting to the Mission Systems Lead, you will own payload interfaces, interoperability, mission development, and reference mission kits. You will ensure payloads meet customer mission requirements and integrate with the vehicle platform and autonomy stack.

Your spectrum of support will be diverse in nature and require you to leverage your technical expertise as well as leadership skills to set objectives, build cross-functional teams, and rapidly drive to completion. The ability to leverage your intuition and prior experience will be key in making sure the right design, analysis, and test steps are completed to ensure success. The ideal candidate will leverage their experience executing and successfully completing prior highly optimized multi-disciplinary projects.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own payload architecture: mechanical, electrical, and software interfaces for all mission payloads

• Drive integration of Anduril payloads and government-furnished equipment onto the platform

• Drive interoperability standards for payload modularity across vehicle configurations

• Develop reference mission kits that package payloads with autonomy behaviors for specific mission sets

• Define payload interface requirements and work with Vehicle Systems on accommodation

• Manage payload integration schedule and cost across prototype and production phases

• Coordinate with third-party vendors on payload qualification and integration

• Provide technical mentorship to engineers across payload disciplines

• Support testing and field deployment of payload systems

• Represent the payload subsystem in technical and customer meetings

• Interface with Mission Systems Lead and autonomy team on mission system integration

ABOUT THE JOB
The Data Product Owner leads several cross-functional scrum teams responsible for delivering outcome-based data solutions to the business. This role is defined by the problems it solves , not the technology it uses. Whether the right answer is a Tableau dashboard, a Snowflake Cortex agent, a Python-based insight package delivered as a Streamlit portal, or a reusable component of our semantic model, the Data Product Owner is accountable for choosing the approach that best achieves the desired outcome and for guiding their teams to build it.

Our stakeholders are primarily internal, though some solutions serve external audiences, and their needs evolve quickly. This person must be comfortable operating in an environment where both Technology and Product direction change, treating that change as a normal condition rather than a disruption. A major part of the mandate is enablement: building the foundational pieces - starting with a well-structured semantic model - that let stakeholders and teams across the organization build their own solutions, inside and outside of Technology. title: Jr Controllership Analyst - Brazil
description:
ABOUT ARQ

ARQ is one of the fastest-growing fintechs in the world. Our mission is to redefine how people interact with money across borders, building the backbone to move value seamlessly. We’re still early in our journey, which means every person who joins shapes the future of our product, culture, and growth. If you’re excited by big challenges, global impact, and the chance to grow fast with a world-class team, ARQ is the place to do it.

The Role
As a Junior Controllership Analyst, you will be part of the team that ensures the quality of ARQ’s accounting and financial information across multiple geographies, with an initial focus on Brazil. With support and mentorship from the senior team and local controllers, you will take part in day-to-day accounting and the monthly close, reconciliations, and regulatory reporting, learning first-hand how a regulated fintech operates at scale and across different jurisdictions. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to grow fast in a highly complex environment, with international exposure and constant learning.

What you’ll be doing

- Journal Entries & Month-End Close: Prepare journal entries and support the monthly close of the group’s entities across more than one geography, following the calendar and routines defined by the team.

- Reconciliations: Perform bank, general ledger, and customer balance reconciliations, identifying differences and supporting the investigation and resolution of open items.

- Regulatory Reporting: Support the preparation and validation of documents and reports to local regulators (such as CADOCs to the Central Bank in Brazil), together with the senior team.

- Financial Statements: Support the preparation of trial balances and financial statements for the group’s entities, including notes to the financial statements, and assist with requests from the local external audits and the consolidated audit.

- Tax Obligations & Intercompany: Support accounting-to-tax reconciliations, tax and withholding tracking, and the recording of intercompany transactions between group entities.

- Local Accounting Standards & Consolidation: Support the understanding of differences between each country’s accounting practices (such as Brazilian GAAP/CPC, US GAAP, and IFRS) and the preparation of information for the group consolidation.

- Process Improvement: Help document routines and identify automation opportunities, working with Finance, Product, and Data.

What you’ll need

- Degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field (final year or completed)

- 1 to 2 years of experience in accounting or controllership (internships count)

- Basic knowledge of statutory accounting and Brazilian accounting practices (CPC)

- Intermediate Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, reconciliations)

- Organization, attention to detail, and commitment to deadlines

- Eagerness to learn and to work at a fast pace

- Intermediate English

Nice-to-haves

- Experience in a financial institution, fintech, consulting, or audit

- Familiarity with COSIF, CADOC, and Central Bank regulation

- Familiarity with US GAAP, IFRS, or accounting in other Latin American countries

- Familiarity with accounting ERPs and data tools (SQL, Power BI)

- Knowledge of payments, FX, or digital asset products

- Postgraduate degree, MBA, or certifications in progress (CRC, IFRS)

title: Submittal Clerk
description:
Submittal Clerk

• Work Type: Full-time.

• Schedule: Standard US business hours, with occasional overtime and weekend work required based on bid schedules and workload demands.

• Location: 100% Remote.

Role Overview
We are seeking a highly organized and specialized administrative professional to serve as a Submittal Clerk. Operating in the critical space between pre-construction and operations, you will be responsible for generating, organizing, and tracking technical product data and comprehensive submittal packages. By meticulously managing the technical document approval process, you will prevent ordering delays and ensure that all proposed materials match project specifications and receive design team approval prior to procurement.
Key Responsibilities

• Specification Review: Review project specifications and contract documents to precisely identify all required submittals, LEED documentation, warranties, and closeout requirements.

• Package Assembly: Gather product data sheets, Safety Data Sheets (SDS), color charts, and testing data from manufacturers to assemble comprehensive and accurate submittal packages.

• Tracking & Follow-Up: Log all outgoing submittals, rigorously track review times, and follow up proactively with General Contractors (GCs) or Architects regarding "Revise and Resubmit" or "Approved as Noted" statuses.

• Internal Distribution: Distribute approved submittals to the project management and purchasing teams to facilitate accurate, timely material ordering.

• Project Closeout: Assist in compiling Operations and Maintenance (O&M) manuals and warranty documentation at project completion.

Requirements & Qualifications

• Experience: 1-3 years of professional experience in construction administration, document control, or project engineering.

• Technical Proficiency: Demonstrated ability to read and navigate construction specifications (specifically Division 7 and Division 8). Familiarity with construction management software (e.g., Procore) for executing submittal workflows.

• Core Competencies: High attention to detail, accuracy, and rigorous documentation practices. Effective written and verbal communication skills. Must be able to pass a pre-employment screening.

• Remote Infrastructure: Must have a dedicated, noise-free home office setup equipped with a reliable, high-speed internet connection and a backup power source.

Benefits of Working for Hyre

• Performance-based raises.

• Minimum 5 days off annually (paid or unpaid based on client terms).

• Annual cost-of-living adjustments at your one-year anniversary.

Job Summary
The Principal Architect, Technology - Enterprise Security is a senior individual contributor responsible for defining and advancing the enterprise security architecture and technical standards that protect Ziply Fiber 's corporate systems, employee infrastructure, and business applications, as well as the network we operate on behalf of 1M+ broadband subscribers.

The successful candidate brings deep, hands-on security architecture expertise in a broadband ISP, telecommunications, or critical-infrastructure environment, and the demonstrated ability to translate business risk into technical design and to communicate security architecture to both engineering teams and executive stakeholders.

·Architect firewall and perimeter strategy: next-generation firewall platform selection (Palo Alto, Fortinet, or equivalent), zone and trust-boundary design, rule-governance and change standards, and policy-lifecycle design.

·Design secure remote-access architecture: ZTNA/SASE platform strategy, VPN-replacement roadmap, split-tunnel and posture-check standards, and endpoint-security integration.
